notes.title: Who We Are Now Art Book and Soundtrack Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

Thanks so much for your support of Who We Are Now! If you are interested in having a special look at the art or music of the game, the art book and soundtrack are out now as DLC!

The art book is 68 pages of completed art, sketches, concept art, and some information about the concept and design of the characters.

The soundtrack is 10 tracks in .M4A format.

Both DLC are $9.99, and can be found in their own folders in the game directory once installed.

Art Book store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091291/Who_We_Are_Now__Art_Book/?beta=0

Soundtrack store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091290/Who_We_Are_Now__Soundtrack/?beta=0

Enjoy, and thanks so much for your support!
